يستقبحون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْبِحُونَ (yastaqbiḥūna) /jas.taq.bi.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# يُسْتَقْبَحُونَ (yustaqbaḥūna) /jus.taq.ba.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
